proof_body:
by
  intro m n x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x y hm hn hne
  have hk : m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : m ^ 2 = n ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ hm.le hn.le two_ne_zero).mp this
  have hP : 0 ≤ (x - x₁) ^ 2 + (y - y₁) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (x - x₂) ^ 2 + (y - y₂) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsq : n * Real.sqrt ((x - x₁) ^ 2 + (y - y₁) ^ 2) = m * Real.sqrt ((x - x₂) ^ 2 + (y - y₂) ^ 2) ↔ n ^ 2 * ((x - x₁) ^ 2 + (y - y₁) ^ 2) = m ^ 2 * ((x - x₂) ^ 2 + (y - y₂) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hP, Real.sq_sqrt hQ]
  have key : (x - (m ^ 2 * x₂ - n ^ 2 * x₁) / (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ^ 2 + (y - (m ^ 2 * y₂ - n ^ 2 * y₁) / (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ^ 2 - m ^ 2 * n ^ 2 * ((x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2) / (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ^ 2 = (m ^ 2 * ((x - x₂) ^ 2 + (y - y₂) ^ 2) - n ^ 2 * ((x - x₁) ^ 2 + (y - y₁) ^ 2)) / (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz : m ^ 2 * ((x - x₂) ^ 2 + (y - y₂) ^ 2) - n ^ 2 * ((x - x₁) ^ 2 + (y - y₁) ^ 2) = 0 := by linarith
    rw [hz, zero_div] at key
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [h, sub_self] at key
    have := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp key.symm).resolve_right hk
    linarith
